title: Design: sutra_dupes — clone detection
description:
Design clone detection for sutra. Largest scope of the design tasks; every choice changes implementation effort and result quality dramatically.

**Open questions:**
- Algorithm: hash-only exact-match first cut, or suffix array for partial/fuzzy?
- Normalization strictness levels — whitespace? identifiers? literals? (Fallow has 4 levels: strict / mild AST / weak / semantic.)
- Minimum clone size — token count or line count?
- Clone families (transitive grouping) vs. pairwise reports.
- Cross-file only or include same-file repetition?

**Recommendation already in docs/feature-ideas.md:** start with function-body-token-hash exact matches. Catches the most common case (copy-pasted functions) at fraction of the effort. Suffix array later if needed.

**Output:** design doc in docs/plans/ choosing algorithm, normalization, clone-family policy.

Reference: docs/feature-ideas.md → "sutra_dupes" (fallow #6).

acceptance_criteria.text: Algorithm choice (hash-only vs suffix-array) decided with rationale
Output schema (clone groups, pairwise, similarity score) defined
